title: Undo and series moves no longer cancel occurrences in Google
steps: A Preview has the Sample calendar, which has no Google behind it, so what Google would have done doesn't show here. The pull request says how to see it with `npm run dev -- --fake-google`.
⌘⇧P, Show calendar. Rename one Standup to Kickoff and choose This event. Undo it from History: it's Standup again, at its time, and still there after the calendar syncs.
Delete one Standup with This event, then undo it: it comes back.
